messages.subject: REMINDER: May time entries due by 3 June
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Our records show you have unposted time for the period 1-31 May. Please ensure all time entries are recorded and released in the system by 17:00 on Wednesday 3 June so that May bills can be raised on schedule.

If you have any queries about a specific matter narrative, contact the billing team.

Regards,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
